The '''Heavy Tactical Fighting Unit (H-TFU)''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model developed by [[Delban Serv-O-Droid]].

==Overview==
These droids were developed for security purposes across the galaxy. A number of them were purchased by the [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] mining guild who modified them to become formidable droids to help patrol as well as guard its interests in the system. They were built to withstand a wide range of harsh planetary conditions with their armored hulls capable of resisting massive impacts, heavy attacks and other traumas that would destroy a lesser droid model.

They were typically armed with only a powerful claw arm capable of detaining thieves and other undesirables. Bespin miners had modified the local fighting units to include a retractable [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] and were also armed with a deadly cutting laser. They moved about on a single wheel leg.

==History==
The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Kleef]] had a pair of H-TFUs serving him, which he set loose against [[Galen Marek]]. However, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] managed to defeat them by using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to break them apart.
